home.heading: Welcome to Zamplia !
home.introText: We're thrilled to have you here as part of our community! By participating in our surveys, you're unlocking the chance to earn exciting rewards and make your voice heard. To ensure you get the best experience and rewards possible, here are a few simple tips:
home.tip1.heading: Be Honest & Thoughtful
home.tip1.text: Your honest answers help us offer better opportunities and increase your chances of earning top rewards!!
home.tip2.heading: Take Your Time
home.tip2.text: Rushing through surveys may disqualify you from rewards, so take your time and make each response count!
home.tip3.heading: Keep it Genuine
home.tip3.text: We use advanced systems to detect suspicious activity, and surveys with inconsistent or automated responses will be removed.
home.tip4.heading: Maximize your Rewards
home.tip4.text: Follow these tips to provide valuable insights and stay eligible for the best rewards on our platform!
home.footermessage: Please avoid refreshing or leaving the page until the survey is complete. Stay focused and answer carefully to prevent uncessary termination!
home.mobileFooterMessage: Stay on this page until you're done!

cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy describes how Zamplia Ltd. (“Zamplia” or “we”, “our” or “us”) uses Cookies and similar technologies. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.
cookies.cookiesDescription: Cookies are small pieces of data that are stored on your computer, mobile phone, or other device when you first visit a page. We use cookies, web beacons, locally shared objects (sometimes called “flash cookies”), mobile identifiers, and similar technologies (“Cookies”) to help us recognize you on Zamplia, enhance your user experience, and understand Zamplia usage.
cookies.typesIntro: We may set Cookies when you visit Zamplia. They may also be set by other websites or services that run content on the page you’re visiting. After you register at our sites, including www.zamplia.com, we may connect information stored in Cookies with other information received from you.
cookies.typesNote: The provision of your data via Cookies is voluntary. The use of Cookies may include the collection, processing, and/or use of personal data in countries outside the European Economic Area, which do not provide the same level of data protection as in your country. You can withdraw your consent at any time by deleting the Cookies.
cookies.typesQuestion: What types of Cookies do we use?
cookies.typesAnswer: We use two types of Cookies on Zamplia:
cookies.sessionCookies: Session Cookies – Temporary cookies that are deleted when you leave Zamplia.
cookies.persistentCookies: Persistent Cookies – Remain on your device until manually deleted.
cookies.usageIntro: Cookies may transmit information about you and your use of Zamplia, such as your browser type and device information. Cookies may link to certain unique information, such as the job titles you entered during registration or on your profile, but this is not linked to your name.
cookies.auth: Authentication – To help us authenticate you to deliver personalized survey content.
cookies.performance: Performance – To make Zamplia easier and faster to use.
cookies.features: Features – To enable features and store information about you and your use of Zamplia.
cookies.analytics: Analytics & Research – To monitor and evaluate the use of Zamplia.
cookies.adChoicesText: You may be able to disable some (but not all) Cookies by adjusting your browser settings, though this may worsen your user experience. Additionally, you can manage and delete cookies through your browser settings. A useful resource for information on deleting and controlling cookies can be found at <aboutCookies>AboutCookies.org</aboutCookies>. Please note that if ads or other features on Zamplia are provided by third parties, they may set and use their own Cookies subject to their privacy policies. Zamplia does not have access to or control over these Cookies.
cookies.policyText: You can delete cookies on your device and/or change your browser or device settings. Some parts of our site may not function correctly if you disable cookies.
cookies.avoidCookiesTitle: How else can I avoid cookies?
cookies.avoidCookiesText: Generally, any personal information collected in the course of an interview is not disclosed to third parties. However, in some cases, a client sponsoring a research project may want to contact respondents directly. In such cases, Zamplia explains the reason for disclosure and obtains express permission before making any such disclosure.
cookies.emailCookiesText: Our emails contain cookies that track whether you open them and click on any links. These cookies are unique to each email and are not stored on your computer or mobile device.
cookies.securityText: Our platform uses device fingerprinting and behavioral tracking technologies solely for security and fraud prevention. These tools help us verify genuine users and prevent automated or malicious activity. No personal information is collected unless you explicitly provide it (such as in survey responses).
cookies.securityPoint1: We do not use cookies for advertising or cross-site tracking.
cookies.securityPoint2: Device fingerprint data is only processed after you accept our policies and is deleted after 30 days.
cookies.securityPoint3: You can opt out by leaving the platform before accepting.
cookies.questionsText: If you have any questions after reading this Cookies Policy, please contact <emailLink>privacy@zamplia.com</emailLink>.

privacy.intro1: Zamplia Ltd. (“Zamplia”) is a market research company, specializing in data collection. At Zamplia, respecting privacy is an important part of our commitment to respondents and the general public.
privacy.intro2: When you participate in survey research conducted by our organization, whether in person, by telephone, mail, or online, you can be assured that your individual responses will be kept confidential. Your personal identifying information will never be sold to anyone. You are free to choose whether or not to participate in a survey, free to choose not to answer any specific questions, and free to discontinue participation at any time.
privacy.intro3: Zamplia privacy policy is a statement of principles and guidelines describing the level of protection of personal information provided by Zamplia to respondents and the general public. The objective of Zamplia privacy policy is to promote responsible and transparent personal information management practices in a manner consistent with the provisions of the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (Canada), the General Data Protection Regulations (EU), and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). We are a member of Canadian Research and Insights Council (CRIC), American Association for Public Opinion Research (AAPOR), and Insights Association. These organizations set standards to which members must adhere and which also protect your privacy.
privacy.collectionIntro: Zamplia shall limit the collection of personal information to that which is necessary for the identified purposes. Zamplia shall identify the purposes for which personal information is collected at or before the time the information is collected
privacy.collectionPoint1: Through the marketing and social research we conduct, including face-to-face, telephone, and online, Zamplia may collect personal data that can identify you, such as your name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address. We will use reasonable commercial efforts to follow all legal requirements in the applicable jurisdiction regarding your consent to collect this information
privacy.collectionPoint2: As a Data Processor, we may be passed information, lawfully collected by our clients, who would like you to participate in market research. This information may include your full name, job title, company name, email address, telephone number, mailing address, and other personally identifiable information.
privacy.collectionPoint3: When choosing to participate in our online panels or surveys, Zamplia will collect registration data which may include information you update in your profile, personal data such as your full name, mailing address, email address.
privacy.collectionPoint4: When participating in online research or visiting our corporate websites, we may automatically capture, through the use of cookies and/or log files, your IP address, geographical location, web browser information.
privacy.useIntro: Zamplia shall specify orally, electronically, or in writing the identified purposes of the market research activity to the respondent at or before the time personal information is collected. Upon request, persons collecting personal information shall explain these identified purposes or refer the individual to a designated person within Zamplia who can explain the purposes. When personal information that has been collected is to be used or disclosed for a purpose not previously identified, the new purpose shall be identified prior to use. Unless the new purpose is permitted or required by law, the consent of the respondent will be acquired before the information will be used or disclosed for the new purpose. Zamplia may provide clients or other third parties with information from any survey, in aggregate form. In aggregate form, it is impossible to identify an individual respondent’s personal information.
privacy.useSubtitle: Zamplia collects and uses personal data from the public only for the following purposes:
privacy.usePoint1: Conducting quantitative and qualitative marketing and social research.
privacy.usePoint4: To verify the responses you provided us with, in a recent market research study.
privacy.usePoint5: Dealing with inquiries and requests about our services submitted to us via email or phone
privacy.usePoint6: To meet legal and regulatory requirements.
privacy.usePoint7: To investigate suspected fraudulent activity in connection with the website or violation of another party’s rights.
privacy.usePoint8: To respond to requests you may make of us, including to provide services that you have requested and participate in surveys or panels you have joined.
privacy.consentText:
The knowledge and consent of an individual are required for the collection, use, or disclosure of personal information. Participation by respondents in survey research is always voluntary. The identified purposes shall be stated in a clear and concise manner that can be reasonably understood by the respondent. As required by law, consent will be given with a statement or a clear affirmative action, specific to the processing, that is informed and freely given.
Generally, any personal information collected in the course of an interview is not disclosed to third parties. However, occasionally, a client sponsoring a research project may want to contact respondents directly. In these cases, Zamplia always explains the reason for the disclosure to the respondent and obtains express permission from the respondent before making any such disclosure. A respondent is always free to choose whether or not to participate in a survey, free to choose not to answer any specific questions, and free to discontinue participation at any time
privacy.sensitiveText:
While collecting data for market research activities, Zamplia may process “Sensitive data” which is defined as personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, or trade union membership, and the processing of genetic data, biometric data for the purpose of uniquely identifying a natural person, data concerning health or data concerning a natural person’s sex life or sexual orientation. Such data will only be processed in accordance with applicable law.
Zamplia will not process personal data of children without parental consent, in accordance with applicable local law. If Zamplia becomes aware that we have unintentionally collected such data without parental consent, we will delete the data without delay.
privacy.sharingIntro: Zamplia will never pass your personal information on to other organizations for them to use for their own sales or marketing purposes. We will disclose your personal data only for the purposes and to those third parties, as described below. We will take the necessary steps to ensure that your personal data is processed, secured, and transferred according to applicable law.
privacy.sharingPoint1: Zamplia, through its affiliate and related companies, operates multiple companies in Canada and USA. Your personal data may be transferred to one or more Zamplia affiliated companies as needed for data processing. We do not disclose personal data of participants in market research projects to third parties outside Zamplia unless the participants have declared their prior explicit consent for the specific purpose.
privacy.sharingPoint2: To third parties who provide a service to us such as market research data collection companies, email service providers to facilitate sending information to you, data centers to securely host our databases and applications, or data processors. We require these service providers to comply strictly with our instructions and data protection laws within the framework of data processing agreements
privacy.sharingPoint3: To third-party client companies who commission us to conduct market research on their behalf. Any legal requirements pertaining to the transfer of personal data to these companies will be adhered to
privacy.sharingPoint4: To a public authority or agent of a public authority as required to comply with the law; or if, in the reasonable judgment of Zamplia, it appears that there is imminent danger to life or property which could be avoided or minimized by disclosure of the information.
privacy.securityText: Zamplia shall protect personal information against such risks as loss or theft, unauthorized access, disclosure, copying, use, modification, or destruction, through appropriate security measures, regardless of the format in which it is held. This includes reasonable electronic, physical, and administrative controls and procedures. Zamplia’s information security governance program is closely aligned with international security standards. Only Zamplia’s employees with a business need-to-know, or whose duties reasonably so require, are granted access to personal information about respondents. All of Zamplia’s employees with access to personal information shall be required to respect the confidentiality of that information
privacy.deviceText: We use advanced device fingerprinting and behavioral analytics to protect our platform from fraud and abuse. When you use our services, and only after you have accepted our policies, we may collect technical and behavioral data from your device, including device type, browser information, hardware details, network characteristics, and patterns of interaction (such as mouse movements, typing rhythm, and touch events). This data helps us
privacy.devicePoint1: Verify your authenticity as a user,
privacy.devicePoint2: Prevent fraudulent activity and abuse of our surveys,
privacy.devicePoint3: Ensure each user is unique for survey integrity.
privacy.dataUsePoint1: The data is used exclusively for security and fraud prevention.
privacy.dataUsePoint2: We do not use this data for advertising, profiling beyond security, or sharing with any third party.
privacy.dataUsePoint3: Data is stored securely for a maximum of 30 days, after which it is permanently deleted.
privacy.rightPoint1: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.
privacy.rightPoint2: You may refuse to continue and leave our platform if you do not wish to accept this data collection.
